intro: Coming of Age marks the initial rite of passage for young Skyborne taking their first steps beyond Thendal Village on Zephras Isle. Guided by Ailee Farheart, novices report to village leader Rorian the Dayseeker to receive an ancestral relic and formally pledge their aid to the shen'dorei.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Look at you, bright eyed and ready for adventure! We've been awaiting your arrival and anticipating your much needed help here in Thendal Village. I imagine you are brimming with both nerves and excitement for what is to come. After all, you only get to come of age once in a lifetime.
Go, seek out our village leader Rorian the Dayseeker at the entrance to the greatfather tree just west of here. He will get you started on your journey.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Gale's greetings, friend. I am honored to bestow your coming of age relic today as you are recognized for the potential you bring to the shen'dorei. Our people have faced great hardship and persecution in our complex history.
Today you are given this relic which is one of many held by those before you. Someday when your ashes are scattered to the winds it will pass to another to continue our tradition.
As you take this relic with you know that the winds of home will be with you wherever you travel.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
